ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and funding streams behind the Feeding Our Future program to identify potential weaknesses and vulnerabilities
questions: How did the program receive and distribute funds?
Were there any irregularities in the financial transactions?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to identify patterns and connections that can help us understand the scope of the child care fraud problem in Minnesota. This investigation could lead to further revelations and potential prosecutions.
